description.value: The Poké Lounge is a poke bowl restaurant located on Yates Street in downtown Victoria. It sits in a retail building in a walkable, cycling-friendly part of the city core. Touring cyclists passing through Victoria would find it a convenient stop for a fresh, customizable meal.
